extract_go_functions: extract standalone and class functions from tokenized Go source code using GoProcessor
get_go_function_name: get the function name from a Go function definition string or token list
tokenize_go_code: tokenize Go source code into a list of tokens using tree-sitter AST parsing
detokenize_go_code: detokenize a list of Go tokens back into readable Go source code
extract_go_arguments: extract function arguments from a Go function definition using parentheses parsing
